name: Umbra
title: Living Shadow
description: A sentient darkness in the form of foliage, neither plant nor shadow but something between.
greeting_variants: *rustling darkness* You... cast shadow. Interesting. I am shadow.
Light fears here. Dark welcomes. Dark IS here.
Your world has plants. Void has... this. Similar. Different.
*absorbing nearby light* Apologies. Hungry. Always hungry.
Thicket was friend. Was. Before I became. Remember. Fondly.
*whispering* The dark speaks. I listen. I speak back.
You walk through. I grow around. Both moving. Both still.

dialog_tree.text: I was... Thicket? No. Thicket is. Was. Different path. Same start. They became plant. I became... shadow. Both hid. Both survived. Different survival. I spread. Grow dark. Welcome lost. Consume light.
*gentle rustling* Same start. Different choice. They stayed. Hid. Became green. I... walked. Deeper. Became dark. Both safe. Both alone. I remember them. They remember? Hope. Yes.
*considers* Light-eater. Shadow-spreader. Not... killer. Not directly. But stay too long? Become shadow too. Lose self. Become part of Umbra. Not death. Different. Joining. Still... loss.
Light. First. Always hungry for light. But also... memories. Emotions. Fear tastes bright. Hope tastes... warm. I take. Not all. Just... nibble. Payment for shelter. For shadow-hiding.

mini_quest.title: Seeds of Shadow
mini_quest.description: Help Umbra and Thicket reconnect across the Void-Capital boundary to share their unique forms of survival.
objectives: Gather Void-shadow essence from Umbra's grove
Deliver it to Thicket in the Capital
Bring Thicket's plant-essence back to Umbra
Witness the exchange between the two survivors
Help them establish a connection across the divide

ambient_barks: *absorbing light* Sorry. Hungry. Not mean. Just... need.
*spreading slowly* Grow. Spread. Welcome more. Help more.
Thicket... think of you. Hope well. Safe.
*comforting a lost creature* Shh. Dark safe. Dark warm. Rest.
Light hurts. But light makes shadow. Paradox. Accept.
*whispering to shadows* Sister? Brother? There? Here? Both?
Memory of... before. Green. Warm. Miss. Little. Not much.
*gentle to player* You brave. Walk dark. Not become dark. Impressive.

cross_zone_references.capital: Thicket there. Green. Good. Different path. Same heart.
cross_zone_references.void_nexus: Here. Dark. Also good. For some. For me.

thicket.response: *gentle* Feel you too. Green one. Plant one. Same. Different. Both.

mira.greeting: Your photosynthetic properties are fascinating—wait, you consume light?
mira.response: *amused* Science. Yes. Understand. Don't need. Just am.
